table.name: client_tenant_mapping
table.remarks: Maps API Gateway client IDs to CSTAR tenants. Enables service-to-service access by linking OAuth2 client credentials (from API Portal) to authorized tenants. One client can access multiple tenants.

column.name: id
column.remarks: Unique identifier for this mapping record.

column.name: client_id
column.remarks: API Gateway client ID (issued via API Portal). Not a foreign key as the API Gateway is external.

column.name: tenant_id
column.remarks: Foreign key to tenant.id. Identifies which CSTAR tenant this client_id can access. The tenant record is created automatically when the mapping is created if it does not already exist.

column.name: is_active
column.remarks: Whether this mapping is currently active. Can be used to temporarily disable client access without deleting the record.

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Timestamp when the mapping was created (via link-client-to-tenants endpoint).

column.name: created_by
column.remarks: User GUID of the admin who created this mapping. Serves as audit trail for who authorized the client.

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Timestamp when the mapping was last updated. Automatically maintained by trigger.

column.name: updated_by
column.remarks: User GUID of the admin who last updated this mapping.

column.name: is_deleted
column.remarks: Soft delete flag. When true, the mapping is excluded from normal queries. Allows audit trail preservation.

table.name: configuration
table.remarks: Stores application configuration values as JSONB for runtime validation and limits.

column.name: key
column.remarks: Unique configuration key. Primary key.

column.name: config
column.remarks: Configuration payload stored as JSONB. Includes value, type, and description metadata.

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Timestamp when the configuration record was created.

column.name: created_by
column.remarks: User or process that created this record.

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Timestamp when the configuration record was last updated. Automatically maintained by trg_configuration_updated_at trigger.

column.name: updated_by
column.remarks: User or process that last updated this record.

table.name: feature_flag
table.remarks: Feature flags table - enables/disables features dynamically without redeployment. Supports global flags (tenant_id = NULL) and per-tenant overrides. Resolution strategy: tenant-specific flag > global flag > default false.

column.name: id
column.remarks: Unique identifier (UUID) for this feature flag record.

column.name: code
column.remarks: Foreign key to feature_flag_code lookup table. Defines which feature this flag controls. Ensures only valid feature codes are used.

column.name: enabled
column.remarks: Boolean flag indicating if this feature is currently enabled (true) or disabled (false). Defaults to false (safer: disabled by default).

column.name: tenant_id
column.remarks: Foreign key to tenant table. NULL = global flag applies to all tenants. Non-NULL = tenant-specific override. Cascade delete if tenant is deleted.

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Timestamp (with timezone) when this feature flag record was created. Automatically set to NOW() on insert.

column.name: created_by
column.remarks: Identifier (username, UUID, email) of the user or process that created this record. Useful for audit trail and change tracking.

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Timestamp (with timezone) when this feature flag was last updated. Automatically maintained by the trg_feature_flag_updated_at trigger.

column.name: updated_by
column.remarks: Identifier (username, UUID, email) of the user or process that last updated this record. Useful for audit trail and change tracking.

table.name: feature_flag_code
table.remarks: Lookup table for valid feature flag codes. Defines all available features that can be toggled. Prevents typos and ensures consistency across backend/frontend. Follows notification_channel_code pattern.

column.name: code
column.remarks: Unique feature code identifier (kebab-case convention, e.g. sms_notifications, sse_notifications). Used by backend/frontend to check if feature is enabled. Primary key ensures one definition per code.

column.name: display_name
column.remarks: Human-readable name for this feature (e.g. SMS Notifications, Server-Sent Events). Displayed in admin UI for clarity.

column.name: description
column.remarks: Detailed description of what this feature does and its purpose. Used in admin UI for documentation and context.

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Timestamp when this code definition was created. Automatically set to NOW() on insert.

column.name: created_by
column.remarks: Identifier of user or process that created this code definition.

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Timestamp when this code definition was last updated. Automatically maintained by the trg_feature_flag_code_updated_at trigger.

column.name: updated_by
column.remarks: Identifier of user or process that last updated this code definition.

table.name: identity_provider
table.remarks: Stores the external authentication providers supported by the system (e.g. IDIR, BCeID).

column.name: id
column.remarks: Unique identifier for the identity provider.

column.name: code
column.remarks: Short code representing the provider. Sample values: IDIR, BCEID_BASIC, BCEID_BUSINESS.

column.name: hint
column.remarks: Login hint passed to the identity provider to guide the authentication flow.

column.name: name
column.remarks: Human-readable name of the provider (e.g. IDIR, BCeID Basic, BCeID Business).

column.name: is_active
column.remarks: Indicates whether this identity provider is currently active and available for authentication.

table.name: mime_type_code
table.remarks: Code table for allowed attachment MIME types. Defines which MIME types can be used for inline attachments in notification requests.

column.name: code
column.remarks: MIME type code (e.g., application/pdf). Primary key.

column.name: description
column.remarks: Human-readable description of the MIME type.

column.name: display_name
column.remarks: Sentence-case display name for UI rendering (e.g., "PDF Document", "PNG Image"). Used in dropdowns and forms.

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Timestamp when the MIME type code was created.

column.name: created_by
column.remarks: User or process that created this record.

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Timestamp when the MIME type code was last updated. Automatically maintained by trg_mime_type_code_updated_at trigger.

column.name: updated_by
column.remarks: User or process that last updated this record.

table.name: notification_channel_code
table.remarks: Code table for notification channel types. Channel codes are uppercase (EMAIL, SMS). This ensures consistency with the NotificationChannel TypeScript enum.

column.name: channel_code
column.remarks: Channel code (e.g., EMAIL, SMS). Primary key.

column.name: description
column.remarks: Human-readable description of the channel.

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Timestamp when the channel code was created.

column.name: created_by
column.remarks: User or process that created this record.

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Timestamp when the channel code was last updated.

column.name: updated_by
column.remarks: User or process that last updated this record.

column.name: display_name
column.remarks: Sentence-case display name for UI rendering (e.g., "Email", "SMS"). Used in dropdowns and forms.

table.name: notification_event_type_code
table.remarks: Code table for notification event types. Defines all valid events that can trigger notifications.

column.name: event_type_code
column.remarks: Event type code (e.g., PASSWORD_RESET, INVOICE_SENT). Primary key.

column.name: description
column.remarks: Human-readable description of the event type.

column.name: is_mandatory
column.remarks: Flag indicating if this event type is mandatory for all tenants.

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Timestamp when the event type code was created.

column.name: created_by
column.remarks: User or process that created this record.

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Timestamp when the event type code was last updated.

column.name: updated_by
column.remarks: User or process that last updated this record.

column.name: display_name
column.remarks: Sentence-case display name for UI rendering (e.g., "Password Reset", "Invoice Sent"). Used in dropdowns and forms.

table.name: notification_request
table.remarks: Stores all incoming notification requests for auditing and tracking

column.name: id
column.remarks: Unique identifier for the notification request

column.name: tenant_id
column.remarks: Tenant that submitted the request

column.name: status
column.remarks: Processing status of the notification request

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Timestamp when the request was created

column.name: created_by
column.remarks: User or system that created the request

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Timestamp when the request was last updated

column.name: updated_by
column.remarks: User or system that last updated the request

column.name: payload
column.remarks: Stores the request payload as JSON for retry purposes when Redis is temporarily unavailable

column.name: error_reason
column.remarks: Stores the error message when a notification fails, useful for debugging and monitoring

column.name: channel_code
column.remarks: The primary channel type for this notification (EMAIL, SMS, MSGAPP, or MULTIPLE if multiple channels)

column.name: delayed_send_time
column.remarks: When set, indicates the notification should be delivered at this time instead of immediately

column.name: recipients
column.remarks: Stores recipients as JSONB object with channels as keys (email, sms, msgApp), each containing an array of recipient addresses/identifiers

column.name: quarantine_details
column.remarks: JSONB data structure storing ClamAV quarantine information. Example: {"viruses": ["Win.Test.EICAR_HDB-1"], "filename": "document.pdf", "scannedAt": "2026-05-19T10:30:00Z", "reason": "Malware detected during content scanning"}

table.name: notification_request_detail
table.remarks: Tracks individual delivery status for each recipient in a notification request

column.name: id
column.remarks: Unique identifier for this delivery attempt

column.name: notification_request_id
column.remarks: Reference to the parent notification request

column.name: recipient_address
column.remarks: Address of the recipient (email, phone number, etc)

column.name: channel
column.remarks: Channel used for delivery (email, sms, etc)

column.name: email_address_type
column.remarks: Email address role (primary, cc, bcc); null for non-email channels

column.name: status
column.remarks: Current delivery status (pending, sent, failed, bounced)

column.name: provider_response_id
column.remarks: Message ID or transaction ID from the provider (GC Notify, etc)

column.name: provider_response
column.remarks: Full JSON response from the provider for debugging

column.name: error_message
column.remarks: Error message if delivery failed

column.name: attempt_count
column.remarks: Number of delivery attempts made

column.name: last_attempt_at
column.remarks: Timestamp of the most recent delivery attempt

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Timestamp when the delivery record was created

column.name: created_by
column.remarks: User or system that created the record

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Timestamp when the record was last updated

column.name: updated_by
column.remarks: User or system that last updated the record

column.name: batch_id
column.remarks: Groups recipients of a bulk send into a single delivery batch, formatted as {notification_request id}-{channel}-{index}; null for non-bulk requests

table.name: notification_request_history
table.remarks: Immutable audit log of all changes to notification_request. Each row captures a complete snapshot after INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE. Populated automatically by audit_history() trigger.

column.name: h_id
column.remarks: Unique identifier for this history record

column.name: target_row_id
column.remarks: Foreign key to notification_request.id that was changed

column.name: operation_type
column.remarks: Type of operation: I=INSERT, U=UPDATE, D=DELETE

column.name: operation_user
column.remarks: User who performed the operation (from app.current_user or database user)

column.name: operation_executed_at
column.remarks: Server timestamp when operation occurred (always NOW() at trigger time)

column.name: data_after_operation
column.remarks: Complete JSON snapshot of the row after the operation. For UPDATE/INSERT: NEW row. For DELETE: OLD row.

table.name: notification_status_code
table.remarks: Lookup table for notification request statuses

column.name: code
column.remarks: Unique status code identifier

column.name: description
column.remarks: Human-readable description of the status

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Timestamp when the record was created

column.name: created_by
column.remarks: User or system that created the record

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Timestamp when the record was last updated

column.name: updated_by
column.remarks: User or system that last updated the record

column.name: display_name
column.remarks: Sentence-case display name for UI rendering (e.g., "Queued", "Processing"). Used in dropdowns and forms.

table.name: notify_user
table.remarks: Represents a user within the Notify system. Users authenticate via external identity providers and are mapped to this internal record.

column.name: id
column.remarks: Unique identifier for the Notify user.

column.name: display_name
column.remarks: Human-readable display name for the user, sourced from the identity provider.

column.name: email
column.remarks: Email address of the user. Must be unique across all Notify users.

column.name: external_id
column.remarks: ID from the identity provider or CSTAR system used to correlate the external identity.

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Timestamp with timezone when the user record was created.

column.name: created_by
column.remarks: Identifier of the user or process that created this record.

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Timestamp with timezone when the user record was last updated. Automatically maintained by trg_notify_user_updated_at trigger.

column.name: updated_by
column.remarks: Identifier of the user or process that last updated this record.

column.name: is_deleted
column.remarks: Soft delete flag. When true, the user is considered inactive and excluded from normal queries.

column.name: username
column.remarks: Username of the user, sourced from the identity provider. Used for audit trail display.

column.name: given_name
column.remarks: Given name (first name) of the user, sourced from the identity provider (givenName claim).

column.name: family_name
column.remarks: Family name (last name) of the user, sourced from the identity provider (familyName claim).

table.name: template
table.remarks: Templates for notifications. Each template is scoped to a tenant and can be used to render notifications across different channels.

column.name: id
column.remarks: Template ID (UUID). Primary key.

column.name: tenant_id
column.remarks: Tenant ID (UUID). Identifies which tenant owns this template.

column.name: name
column.remarks: Template name. Must be unique within the tenant.

column.name: description
column.remarks: Optional description of what this template is for.

column.name: channel_code
column.remarks: Foreign key to notification_channel_code. Defines which channel this template is for (EMAIL, SMS, etc.).

column.name: subject
column.remarks: Email subject line. Only applicable for EMAIL templates.

column.name: body
column.remarks: Template body content with placeholders.

column.name: engine_code
column.remarks: Foreign key to template_engine_code. Defines which rendering engine to use.

column.name: version
column.remarks: Version number of the template. Auto-increments with each update.

column.name: active
column.remarks: Flag indicating if this is the active version of the template. Exactly one version per template should be active.

column.name: created_by
column.remarks: User or process that created this template.

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Timestamp when the template was created.

column.name: updated_by
column.remarks: User or process that last updated this template.

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Timestamp when the template was last updated.

table.name: template_engine_code
table.remarks: Code table for template rendering engines. Defines all valid engines for template rendering.

column.name: engine_code
column.remarks: Engine code (e.g., legacy_gc_notify, handlebars, mustache, ejs). Primary key.

column.name: description
column.remarks: Human-readable description of the engine.

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Timestamp when the engine code was created.

column.name: created_by
column.remarks: User or process that created this record.

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Timestamp when the engine code was last updated.

column.name: updated_by
column.remarks: User or process that last updated this record.

column.name: display_name
column.remarks: Sentence-case display name for UI rendering (e.g., "Handlebars", "Mustache"). Used in dropdowns and forms.

table.name: template_version
table.remarks: Historical versions of templates. Allows tracking changes and rolling back to previous versions.

column.name: id
column.remarks: Version record ID (UUID). Primary key.

column.name: template_id
column.remarks: Foreign key to template. Links to the template this version belongs to.

column.name: version
column.remarks: Version number.

column.name: name
column.remarks: Template name at this version.

column.name: description
column.remarks: Template description at this version.

column.name: channel_code
column.remarks: Channel code at this version.

column.name: subject
column.remarks: Email subject at this version.

column.name: body
column.remarks: Template body at this version.

column.name: engine_code
column.remarks: Engine code at this version.

column.name: created_by
column.remarks: User or process that created this version.

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Timestamp when this version was created.

table.name: tenant
table.remarks: Represents an organization or service using BC Notify. All data in the system is scoped under a tenant.

column.name: id
column.remarks: Unique identifier for the tenant.

column.name: external_id
column.remarks: External identifier from CSTAR or Gateway used to correlate this tenant with external systems.

column.name: name
column.remarks: Human-readable name of the tenant organization (e.g. Ministry of Health).

column.name: slug
column.remarks: URL-friendly unique identifier for the tenant (e.g. ministry-of-health). Must be unique across all tenants.

column.name: status
column.remarks: Current status of the tenant. Allowed values: active, disabled.

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Timestamp with timezone when the tenant record was created.

column.name: created_by
column.remarks: Identifier of the user or process that created this record.

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Timestamp with timezone when the tenant record was last updated. Automatically maintained by trg_tenant_updated_at trigger.

column.name: updated_by
column.remarks: Identifier of the user or process that last updated this record.

column.name: is_deleted
column.remarks: Soft delete flag. When true, the tenant is considered inactive and excluded from normal queries.

table.name: tenant_status_code
table.remarks: Code table for tenant status values. Defines all valid statuses for tenants.

column.name: code
column.remarks: Status code (e.g., active, disabled). Primary key.

column.name: description
column.remarks: Human-readable description of the status.

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Timestamp when the status code was created.

column.name: created_by
column.remarks: User or process that created this record.

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Timestamp when the status code was last updated.

column.name: updated_by
column.remarks: User or process that last updated this record.

table.name: user_identity
table.remarks: Links an external identity provider account to an internal Notify user. A single Notify user may have multiple identity links across different providers.

column.name: id
column.remarks: Unique identifier for the identity mapping record.

column.name: user_id
column.remarks: Reference to the internal Notify user this identity belongs to.

column.name: provider_id
column.remarks: Reference to the identity provider used for authentication.

column.name: subject
column.remarks: Unique subject identifier issued by the identity provider for this user (e.g. the sub claim in a JWT).

column.name: token_attributes
column.remarks: Additional identity claims or attributes returned by the provider stored as JSONB (e.g. roles, groups).

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Timestamp with timezone when this identity link was created.

column.name: is_deleted
column.remarks: Soft delete flag. When true, this identity link is considered inactive.

table.name: webhook_config
table.remarks: Stores webhook endpoint configurations per tenant, including the target URL, secret, headers, and rules for which channels and events trigger delivery.

table.name: webhook_delivery_log
table.remarks: Tracks each webhook delivery attempt, including HTTP status, response body, retry scheduling, and final delivery status.

table.name: webhook_type
table.remarks: Defines webhook types that determine the payload format sent to the webhook endpoint.

routine.name: audit_history()
create_template_version_on_update()
set_updated_at()
routine.comment: Reusable trigger function that automatically sets updated_at to the current timestamp on every row update. Add this trigger to any table that has an updated_at column.
